stance_rationale: Cycle 8 is usable as exploratory decay research, but it is not approval-grade risk verification. Required lifecycle artifacts, No Silent Override materials, security-level Sigma decomposition, PIT regime proof, tail-risk/stress tests, and schedule validation are absent or explicitly deferred.

sigma_audit.method_selected: 3-source 36m rolling sample covariance only; no security-level BΩB'+D and no shrinkage estimator

regime_sigma_audit.comment: CRISIS n=7, CAUTION n=27, and BULL n=34 are below risk-prompt adequacy thresholds; no pooled Sigma, bounds shrink, or bootstrap CI is supplied for Cycle 8 regime Sigma use.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: FAIL: Cycle 8 TDC is source-source, not PG2 active-book TDC; inherited AR MCTV 88-101% and AR-to-Hybrid cor 0.997 keep L-219 family saturation unresolved.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Regime correlations use full-sample AR quantiles over the aligned post-2015 sample, then support risk conclusions.
No t-1 regime lag, vol_lag, or dd_lag proof is produced in Cycle 8; C9 is inherited/not directly verified.
KR10y/external time-series lag handling is inherited from master_returns and not auditable from target artifacts.
Security-level factor returns and BΩB'+D decomposition are not produced; covariance.parquet is only 3-source sleeve-level.
Cycle 8 scripts load master_returns CSV rather than directly loading Factor DB parquet.

critical_concerns.description: User-specified stage dirs A/B, alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, formal risk_package.json, alpha/optimization packages, and challenge notes are missing, blocking schedule, walk-forward, No Silent Override, and cross-agent context verification.

The available covariance.parquet passes PD and raw 3-source cond checks, but it is not post-shrink security-level Sigma; B, Omega, D, shrinkage delta, LW/Gerber/RMT/DCC comparison, and factor coverage R2 are absent.
Regime evidence is underpowered and non-PIT: CRISIS n=7 with no bootstrap/pooled fallback, while labels are full-sample same-period AR quantile diagnostics.
Tail-risk checklist fails: Hybrid CVaR95 loss magnitude 7.30% breaches the 2.5% cap, while EVT-GPD, VaR99/ES99, and 8 named stress periods are not produced.
Crowding remains approval-failing: HHI 0.535, inherited AR MCTV 88-101%, and AR-Hybrid style correlation 0.997 mean source diversification is mostly cosmetic at portfolio risk level.

The decay inference is fragile: all Welch p-values exceed 0.05, bootstrap CIs include zero, TSMOM uses a non-canonical mid-sample proxy, and the Bayesian posterior rests on n=3 with assumed likelihood sigma 0.15.
AX-001 v2 is not satisfied: COVID and Stagflation stress inherited failures remain, only 3 of 8 stress periods are measured, and Q07/BAB remediation is deferred rather than verified.
No Silent Override is incomplete because risk_challenge_note.md is explicitly TBD post-Codex and the other 3-agent package context is absent.

supporting_arguments: covariance.parquet in the mailbox has 100 rows from 2017-12 to 2026-03; min eigenvalue is positive and max raw condition number is 46.24367.
The package does disclose major lifecycle blockers, the TSMOM split caveat, and that the produced covariance is not security-level.
Hill alpha for Hybrid is 2.5559, so RF-R6 is not triggered on the historical Hill estimate.
unresolved_disputes: Whether Cycle 8 is merely exploratory meta-research or is being used to justify TERMINATE_BENEFICIAL remains unresolved.
Whether source-source TDC near zero can substitute for PG2 active-book crowding TDC is not established.
Whether the Bayesian posterior should be widened materially under n=3, non-independent sources, and arbitrary likelihood sigma is unresolved.
Whether missing stage artifact paths are a path mismatch or true artifact absence must be resolved before any approval use.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that underpowered 3-source sleeve-level decay diagnostics can justify a termination/effective-diversification conclusion while formal lifecycle risk artifacts and PIT schedule validation remain absent.
rebuttal_required: Produce alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, security-level covariance.parquet, exposure_matrix.parquet, factor_covariance.parquet, and specific_risk.parquet in the declared stage path.
Provide Sigma estimator comparison across Sample/LW/Gerber/RMT/DCC with shrinkage delta, post-shrink cond <=100, min eigenvalue, and factor coverage R2.
Recompute regime diagnostics with t-1 expanding labels and bootstrap CI or pooled fallback for CRISIS n<50.
Produce CVaR/CDaR, VaR99/ES99, EVT-GPD, and all 8 named stress periods; issue infeasibility_report if CVaR cap remains breached.
Define PG2 active-book TDC/HHI/style-correlation measurement and show RF-R1/R3/R5 are below thresholds.

risk_specific_questions: If covariance.parquet is only raw 3-source rolling Sigma, what exact post-shrink security-level Sigma will the optimizer consume?
How can CRISIS n=7 support regime-conditional Sigma or tail-correlation conclusions without bootstrap CI or pooled fallback?
Is TDC measuring source-source dependence, cross-sectional crowding, or PG2 active-book overlap, and which version maps to RF-R3?
